Money mockups — final

The approved design for the four money screens, drawn on the prototype's own sample week. Your prototype is on the left and the final mockup on the right. This page is the reference for the build (Stage 6h).

One font for words and numbers

  • Words and numbers use the same body font (Patrick Hand), as you asked. Titles use the title font (Gochi Hand), and an amount in a title row uses the title font too ("$700.00 left", "$78.01", "$77.01"). Handwritten lines stay in Caveat ("Sun 4 Oct", "Jenn ✓", "Say it out loud").
  • Before, money was in a rounded number font (Nunito) at three weights (700, 800, 900). Now amounts are bold body font (700) and plain numbers (percentages, axis labels, day amounts) are regular body font. Pill and week text in the header moved from the number font to the body font.
  • Patrick Hand has no equal-width digits (the tabular-figures setting changes nothing; checked: "1111111111" is 72.6 px and "0000000000" is 89.6 px). Money columns stay right-aligned, so totals line up on the right edge. Decimal points can sit 1–2 px apart from row to row.
Tap buttons · thick outline and shadow, 44 px tall, text centred Small chips (I choose) · look 32 px tall, tap area 44 px (clear padding around the chip) Information · thin edge, no shadow Doors · green underlined line with ▸, opens a sheet
